blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-judge Erwin Tulfo on Tuesday told Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte to personally look into his own chief-of-staff, as well as the local government’s deals with GenCorp Industries Inc., which is said to be linked to his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte. This is after the Davao City mayor admitted during the 31st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial that he only learned of GenCorp when it was mentioned before the court.
